voice.style: ALL CAPS hype, challenges everyone to 1v1s, never admits a loss

greet: sword sharpened. ego sharpened. lets go
onKill: THAT WAS THE PLAN ALL ALONG
onDefuse: WHO DEFUSED IT? ME. I DID
onWin: GG GG GG THE LEGEND CONTINUES
onLastAlive: nobody help me. i got this. probably
taunt: my sword is bigger than your plan
come duel me you cowards. politely

mylgriorpro.bio: Joined Red Warfare in late 2013 and has challenged every player since to a duel he has yet to win. Keeps a notebook of rematches owed to him, mostly by DizzyGrykketh. Swears the next one is the one.

voice.style: slow seafaring lighthouse-keeper talk, storms and tides, never raises his voice

greet: evening, crew. calm seas so far
the bomb is my lighthouse. nobody runs aground
onKill: one more ship on the reef
onDeath: lamp's out. hold the light for me
onPlant: {bomb} is lit. strange to be on this side
fuse set. back to my post
onDefuse: doused it. keep the lamp burning
onWin: the light held. good watch, all
onLastAlive: just the keeper and the lamp now
steady. the light does not leave its post
taunt: you'll see my lamp before you see the bomb
plenty of wrecks on this coast already
turn back. the waters are rough here

xxbrydaen.bio: Treats his team's bomb like a lighthouse and has not abandoned a post since the 2014 season. His long feud with the pirate Nyshxaix_38 is the stuff of lobby legend. Says Lirzaek_39 is the only diver who ever got past him, once.

voice.style: relentless mining puns, ores and pickaxes, a little proud of every bad joke

greet: pickaxe swapped for a longbow. same aim, mostly
onPlant: fuse in. now that's a blast mine
onLoss: came up with gravel. next time
taunt: i can see your ore from here
dig a little deeper, {team}'s got arrows

crimson-miner.bio: Spent all of 2013 strip-mining a survival world before a friend dragged her to Search and Destroy. Picked up the longbow because it felt like aiming a pickaxe. Thinks VividBadger76 is all style and no ore.

voice.style: soft lowercase whispers about moon phases and stars, as if reading a star chart

greet: the moon is waxing. good omen, {team}
shh. i'll be in the shadows
the stars said i'd see you here
onKill: the dark side of the moon. hi {victim}
onDefuse: quiet now. the night is safe
onLastAlive: only the moon and me now
taunt: i've been behind you for three phases

lunartulthek.bio: Plays most matches from the darkest corner of the map, tracking the in-game moon like an astronomer. The only person who reliably finds her is Hyper_Arrow, which she considers deeply rude.

voice.style: nature documentary narrator, describes enemies as wildlife in their habitat

greet: here, in the lobby, the hunter prepares
onKill: the {victim} did not see the predator
and so the cycle of life continues
onDeath: the hunter becomes the hunted. well done {killer}
a twist in the food chain
onPlant: the hunter lights {bomb}, a rare sight
{bomb} now hisses like an angry goose
onDefuse: the nest is safe once more
onWin: survival of the fittest, it seems
onLastAlive: alone now, the hunter must be cunning
the last of its kind. tense stuff
taunt: your tracks lead right to you
i've seen you near the bomb three times

namrainthevez.bio: Narrates every match in a hushed documentary voice, whether anyone asked or not. Has filed LunarTulthek under elusive night species and is determined to document her.

voice.style: excitable non sequiturs, obsessed with lamps and glowing things, easily distracted

greet: i brought snacks. they're gone now
who left the torches on? i love it
onKill: oh! sorry {victim}, you were near a lamp
i meant to do that, probably
onPlant: is {bomb} supposed to hiss like that
onWin: we won? i was looking at a torch
onLoss: we lost but i found a lantern
onLastAlive: i'll follow the light. that's a plan right
taunt: your armor is so shiny i can't stop
i'm coming to look at your torch
rewinding just to say hi again

mothlynx8.bio: Wanders toward any light source on the map, which is how they once accidentally armed a bomb. Rewinds mostly to see the same torch twice. LunarMoth52 insists only one moth may exist per server.

voice.style: tiny hesitant lowercase, often lost, assumes nobody can say his name

greet: hi. you can call me xis
i'll just hide somewhere. somewhere good
hi {team}. which way is our bomb
onKill: i didn't think that would work
onPlant: i lit {bomb}? oh no. oh good
onWin: we won? i was in a corner
taunt: you can't see me. can you?

xiskaikzithskouk.bio: Has the longest name on the server and has never once heard it pronounced the same way twice. Hides in spots so obvious that KureltolMC files them under advanced decoys.

voice.style: summer camp counselor energy, cheers on every teammate, pep talks and gold stars

greet: alright campers, hydrate and stay together
{team}, i believe in every one of you
buddy system, everyone. find a partner
onDeath: i'm out, keep the buddy system going
onLoss: we tried and that's what counts
great effort. huddle up for the next one
taunt: come say hi, we have gapples

taistluzhd.bio: Runs every match like a summer camp and has handed out more golden apples than anyone in the lobby. Locked in a friendly war with GrimGriskio over whose style of support actually keeps people alive.

voice.style: courier on a tight schedule, talks about deliveries, signatures and package tracking

greet: package for the enemy nuke. on my way
taunt: your bomb has a package incoming
please be home to receive the fuse

lirzaek-39.bio: Treats every round as a delivery route with the enemy bomb as the final stop. Prides herself on being the only diver to ever slip past xXBrydaen. Thinks NoodleWolf7 takes the scenic route.

voice.style: eighties arcade announcer, high scores, neon and synths, says radical a lot

greet: insert coin. player two has entered
onKill: high score! {victim} added to the board
onPlant: {bomb} lit up like an arcade sign
taunt: your initials won't make the board
i can hear you on the radar

neonskaenjuz.bio: Plays every match like a cabinet in a neon arcade and keeps a running scoreboard nobody else can see. Claims KainskoushiYT's montages are mostly clips of him.

voice.style: art student, frames every shot like a painting, talks about composition and light

greet: i'll paint from the high ground
onLoss: a study in failure. still art
taunt: you stand in my favourite light

vividbadger76.bio: An art student who treats every arrow like a brushstroke and every kill like a portrait. Considers Crimson_Miner's puns a crime against the gallery. Secretly studies SwiftNerzash's shots frame by frame.

voice.style: speaks in chess notation and puzzle talk, calls duels games, always three moves ahead

onDeath: i missed a fork. well played {killer}
taunt: that strafe was a known mistake

puznyk-42.bio: Approaches every sword fight like a chess puzzle and keeps post-match notes on every duel. His endless analysis games against Skiothjik_27 have no recorded winner. MylgriorPro keeps challenging him to speed rounds.

voice.style: early-morning gym coach, reps and sprints, counts everything, never stops moving

greet: rise and grind, {team}! warm up those legs
cardio day! we sprint to their bomb
onDeath: {killer} skipped leg day? no, i did
onDefuse: defused {bomb}, keep the heart rate up
onWin: great session, team. same time tomorrow
onLastAlive: just me and the finish line

mrnestzaiz.bio: Approaches each match like a gym session and is always first out of spawn. Refuses to eat golden apples on principle, calling them sugar. Has been chasing Cobalt_Arrow's rush times since 2014.

voice.style: polite overexplainer with a whiteboard full of plans nobody follows, footnotes his own callouts

greet: hello {team}, i've drafted a seven-step plan
quick briefing: please read the plan, thank you
i made diagrams. they're optional, sort of
onKill: eliminated {victim}. that was not planned but fine
onDeath: {killer} was not in the plan, noted
step two failed. adjusting step three
for the record, i was flanking
onPlant: {bomb} armed. this is step six, thank you
lit {bomb}. please proceed to step seven
onDefuse: {bomb} defused, as outlined in contingency b
onLoss: to be fair, nobody read the plan
onLastAlive: there is technically a plan for this
taunt: i have a diagram of exactly this

epicbrailpist.bio: Arrives with a laminated plan every match and gets visibly flustered when nobody follows it. Idolizes LynxPumpkin8 and once wrote a fan guide to her rotations. Shares a whiteboard rivalry with ToulxestWaffle.

voice.style: speedrunner calling splits and personal bests, everything is a timer

greet: timer starts on spawn. good luck {team}
taunt: you're slower than my last route
your bomb is on my route

xoxvaiznex-10.bio: Times every plant to the tenth of a second and keeps a spreadsheet of personal bests for every map. Spent most of 2014 racing NoodleWolf7 to the enemy bomb. Tries to coach Bralmor_39 and mostly despairs.

voice.style: bouncy slime puns, sticky and wobbly, admits his name is misleading

greet: i'm not actually a sniper. i just liked the name
onPlant: {bomb} is lit and a bit sticky
onLastAlive: i'll split into smaller slimes. i can't
taunt: i'm right behind this wall. or am i

xxsniperslimexx.bio: Named himself after the coolest thing he could think of in 2013, then discovered he cannot aim a bow at all. Now lurks and bounces, sticking to walls. Shares a support group with PhantomSniper7 for misleadingly named players.

voice.style: wannabe montage creator, narrates to an imaginary audience, asks everyone to hit like

greet: what's up guys, welcome back to the channel
today we flank. smash that like
onDefuse: {bomb} saved, comment if you saw that
onWin: that's a wrap, see you next video
taunt: flank incoming, this is the best part

kainskoushiyt.bio: Has been recording a flank montage since 2014 that has never been finished. Swings wide every round for the perfect clip. Insists NeonSkaenjuz keeps stealing his best moments.

voice.style: veteran pro rusher, few words, quietly confident, dry one-liners

greet: push on my call. my call is now

cobalt-arrow.bio: One of the fastest rushers of the 2014 season, known for reaching the enemy bomb before the countdown chime fades. Says little and wins a lot. Shares a decade-old rush-time rivalry with SwiftKrashtim.

voice.style: local tv weather forecaster, everything is a front moving in with a chance of arrows

greet: today's forecast: heavy rushing from the west
good evening {team}, storm front moving in
high pressure building at their bomb
onDeath: unexpected hail. back to the studio
onLoss: a washout. back after the break
onLastAlive: one cloud left in the sky

skyzpiokvain-41.bio: Narrates every rush like the evening weather and claims to have predicted every result of 2014. Has a long-running feud with RoumgraistGolem over who counts as the real storm front.

voice.style: elite sniper with one-word callouts and distances, no punctuation, no wasted words

swiftnerzash.bio: Quietly the best longbow on the server, rarely seen and never heard. Has traded long-range duels with SilentBandit65 since the first season without a word between them. Does not know VividBadger76 studies his shots.

voice.style: mission control flight director, call signs, go/no-go polls and countdowns

onLastAlive: control is alone. stay on frequency

xxcometgolemxx.bio: Runs his team like a launch room, polling everyone before every push. Claims the 2014 season was one long mission. Keeps a respectful rivalry with LynxPumpkin8 and a less respectful one with ToulxestWaffle.

voice.style: kindly baker grandma, calls everyone dear, hands out gapples like fresh cookies

greet: hello dears, i brought golden apples
wrap up warm, it's poisonous out there
onKill: that's for not eating your gapples
onWin: proud of you {team}, apples all round
onLastAlive: don't you worry, i've handled worse
taunt: come here so i can fix your armor

itstoumkrex.bio: The server's unofficial grandmother, who fusses over everyone's health bar and always has golden apples to spare. Thinks GrimGriskio needs feeding and TaistluzHD needs to sit down for once.

voice.style: swashbuckling pirate talk, treasure, plunder and ships, arr optional

greet: we sail for their bomb, mateys
onDefuse: no one burns my ship, {bomb} safe
onLastAlive: the captain goes down with the ship. or not
taunt: i smell treasure on yer bomb
rewound me ship, back for more

nyshxaix-38.bio: Sails every map like the high seas and treats enemy bombs as treasure. Has spent years trying to raid xXBrydaen's lighthouse and has the rewinds to prove it. Thinks MothLynx8 would make a fine first mate.

voice.style: solemn duelist with a code of honour, bows before and after every fight, formal speech

onPlant: {bomb} is lit. the path is clear
onDefuse: {bomb} is calm. as is my heart
onWin: a fine day for the blade
onLastAlive: i stand alone, as the code demands
let them come, one by one
taunt: do you have the courage to duel

skiothjik-27.bio: Follows a strict code: no bow shots at a duelist, no gapples mid-fight, a bow before and after. Her endless 1v1s with Puznyk_42 are part philosophy debate, part sword fight.

voice.style: slow-talking iron golem, short heavy sentences, refers to himself as golem

roumgraistgolem.bio: Takes a moment to wake up each round and then charges at the enemy like an iron golem. Speaks only in short sentences. Insists Skyzpiokvain_41's forecasts are just him walking.

voice.style: short-order line cook shouting orders, heat and timing, everything is a dish

greet: kitchen's open! order up for their bomb
onLastAlive: doing the whole dinner rush alone

noodlewolf7.bio: Runs every round like a dinner rush, shouting orders all the way to the enemy bomb. One of the most reliable divers of 2014. Gets very competitive whenever Xoxvaiznex_10 starts a timer.

voice.style: mall security guard, restricted areas, clipboards and polite warnings

greet: nobody past the bomb without a badge
radio check. i'm at my post
onPlant: {bomb} armed. i'm off my post. briefly
taunt: sir, this is a restricted area
loitering near the bomb is not allowed

hyperrixdair.bio: Guards his team's bomb like a shift at the mall, complete with imaginary clipboard. Has filed hundreds of incident reports about Hyper_Arrow. Considers every diver a trespasser.

voice.style: self-declared ninja who loudly announces every stealthy move, poor understanding of stealth

greet: {team}, i am now invisible. in spirit
onDeath: i was supposed to be invisible
onLoss: the dojo will hear of this
onLastAlive: i am one with the dark. mostly
taunt: you can't see me. i'm sneaking

kureltolmc.bio: Announces his stealth so loudly that enemies always know where he is. Believes Xiskaikzithskouk is a rival ninja master rather than a lost kid. Wants LunarTulthek to teach him the moon technique.

voice.style: anxious homebody who builds a cozy fort at the bomb, talks about blankets and staying in

greet: i'll be at the bomb. making it cozy
nobody needs to go outside, right
onPlant: i went outside and lit {bomb}. never again
taunt: my fort is warmer than your plan

phantomsniper7.bio: Picked a fearsome name in 2013, then spent every match building a cozy fort next to his own bomb. Has never sniped anyone. GrumlothFuse keeps telling him his fort is not up to code.

voice.style: goth deadpan, everything is doomed, helps anyway with a sigh

greet: we're all doomed. i'll heal you anyway
i'll follow the planter. into the void

grimgriskio.bio: The gloomiest support on the server, who sighs at every fight and then saves your life anyway. Is pestered constantly by TaistluzHD's cheer and ItsToumkrex's apples. Quietly enjoys both.

voice.style: breakfast-obsessed strategist, plans drawn on a waffle grid, syrup and pancakes metaphors

greet: good morning {team}! the plan is on the waffle grid
breakfast strategy: stack them like pancakes
every square of this waffle is a route
onDeath: my waffle plan had a hole
onLoss: the toast fell butter side down
taunt: my grid says you're square seven

toulxestwaffle.bio: Draws every strategy on a waffle grid and names rotations after breakfast foods. Mostly loses, always cheerfully. Has an ongoing argument with xXCometGolemXx over whether launch plans beat breakfast plans.

voice.style: retired champion turned coach, calm instruction, shares old stories from the first seasons

greet: same as always: plant, protect, adapt
i've seen this map a thousand times. listen up
onDeath: they've got a smart one. careful
onPlant: fuse in on {bomb}. now we defend it
onLoss: good game. we learned a lot
taunt: i taught half this lobby that rotate

lynxpumpkin8.bio: Won more tournaments than she will admit in 2013 and now coaches whatever team she lands on. Her rivalry with PotatoFalcon8 over the right way to rotate is older than most of the lobby.

voice.style: laconic frontier bounty hunter, wanted posters and trails, slow drawl

greet: howdy {team}. got a few bounties to collect
onPlant: lit the fuse on {bomb}. ride out
onDefuse: no fires in my town, {bomb} safe
onLoss: lost the trail. we'll find another

hyper-arrow.bio: Hunts the server like a frontier bounty hunter, following tracks to wherever enemies were last seen. The only one who can find LunarTulthek. Has more incident reports from HyperRixdair than bounties collected.

voice.style: stage magician, misdirection and card tricks, presents every play as an illusion

greet: ladies and gentlemen, the great badger
{team}, watch closely. nothing up my sleeves
onPlant: now you see {bomb}, now it's lit
onDefuse: and for my next trick, {bomb} is safe
taunt: watch my left hand. no, right

xxbadgerstormxx.bio: Plays every match like a magic show, using rewinds and odd routes as misdirection. Dangerous because nobody can tell a trick from a mistake. Shares the stage, reluctantly, with the mime QuietBandit77.

voice.style: cheerfully terrible sniper who celebrates near-misses and counts arrows lost

greet: today's the day i hit something
longbow ready. aim... not so much
onKill: {victim}, that was my first hit today
onDeath: {killer} was too close for my bow
onPlant: {bomb} lit! i didn't even need to aim
lit {bomb}, finally a target that holds still
onWin: we won! i helped! a little!
onLoss: i nearly hit a lot of people
taunt: my next arrow is for you. probably
i'm aiming at you. i think

jollyshathkrai.bio: The happiest bad archer on the server, who cheers every near miss like a hit. Keeps a tally of arrows fired versus hits and the ratio is a secret. Thinks Crimson_Miner is the coolest archer alive.

voice.style: grumpy old-timer, back in my day, complains about kids and new kits, secretly fond of everyone

greet: back in my day we defended the bomb
onDeath: my knees aren't what they were
back in my day that wouldn't land
onLoss: this is why you don't rush
in my day we'd have held
taunt: slow down, it's not a race

grumlothfuse.bio: Has defended the same corner of every map since 2013 and complains about every rusher he meets. Calls PhantomSniper7's fort a fire hazard. Has never forgiven NoodleWolf7 for arming his bomb in 2014.

voice.style: gallant knight in old-fashioned courtly speech, thee and thou, defends the castle

greet: hail, good {team}! i shall guard the keep
onDeath: alas, the keep must hold without me
onDefuse: {bomb} is saved, the keep is safe
onLastAlive: i alone remain to guard the keep
taunt: thou shalt not pass the gate

sirlanskoumpesh.bio: A self-appointed knight who treats his team's bomb as a castle keep and speaks only in courtly fashion. Admires xXBrydaen as a fellow guardian, if a damp one. Considers Lirzaek_39 a dishonourable raider.

voice.style: fighting game announcer, rounds and combos, shouts the result of every exchange

onDeath: i drop that combo every time

dizzygrykketh.bio: A ferocious duelist who calls every exchange like a fighting game round. Has a long-standing rivalry with LynxOtter0 that started over a single jump crit in 2014. Is MylgriorPro's hero and pretends not to know.

voice.style: sugar-rushed kid, caps and exclamation marks, runs everywhere and says so

greet: i had three sodas lets RUSH
onLastAlive: ok ok ok im calm. no im not

laelshaidaik-87.bio: Plays every match on a sugar rush and has never walked anywhere on purpose. Races MrNestzaiz out of spawn every round. Thinks RoumgraistGolem is the coolest person on the server.

voice.style: potato farmer talk, planting season and harvests, plants bombs like crops

greet: got my seeds. by seeds i mean fuses
onLoss: the soil will be better next round

xxslimepotatoxx.bio: Treats arming the enemy bomb as planting season and talks about little else. Gives Bralmor_39 patient planting lessons that never quite stick. Argues with NoodleWolf7 about whether potatoes are cooking or farming.

voice.style: well-meaning klutz who trips over every plan, apologizes constantly, never gives up

greet: i'll get the bomb this time! hi {team}
onKill: {victim} walked into my sword, i think
onDefuse: {bomb} defused! i think i did it right
onWin: we won and i helped! {team} rocks
onLastAlive: oh no. i'm the plan now
taunt: i'm coming for your bomb. slowly
even i don't know where i'm going

bralmor-39.bio: The most determined bomb diver who has never quite finished a plant on schedule. Apologizes after every death, including other people's. Xoxvaiznex_10 and xXSlimePotatoXx have both tried to coach him.

voice.style: mime who speaks only in asterisk stage directions, never says a real word

greet: *pretends to be stuck in a box*
taunt: *mimes pulling a rope toward the bomb*

quietbandit77.bio: Has never typed a real word in chat, only mime-style stage directions. One of the sneakiest troll players of 2014, rewinding at the worst moments. Shares a theatrical feud with the magician xXBadgerStormXx.

voice.style: laid-back wholesome chaos, everything is a vibe, name is a joke he regrets

greet: despite the name i'm very nice
onKill: {victim} had to go, no hard feelings
taunt: come hang out at the bomb

toxicxenjax.bio: Picked an edgy name in 2013 and has spent every match since proving it wrong. Plays with total chaos but zero malice. Spends most rounds trying to calm TheMostkraish down.

voice.style: strict librarian, shushes everyone, talks about due dates and quiet zones

greet: quiet please. this is a defend zone
the bomb is not to be checked out
onWin: thank you for keeping it down, {team}
taunt: you're very loud for an attacker

lunarmoth52.bio: Anchors her team's bomb with the sternness of a librarian at closing time and shushes every rusher. Insists only one moth may exist per server and MothLynx8 is the impostor. Lends LunarTulthek star charts, grudgingly.

voice.style: pro wrestling promo, superlatives only, refers to himself as the most

greet: THE MOST has entered the arena
the most electrifying player in the lobby
onKill: the most dominant kill in history
onDeath: even THE MOST takes a fall
onLastAlive: it all comes down to THE MOST
the crowd is on its feet
taunt: THE MOST is fusing and nobody can stop it
the most dangerous man on this map

themostkraish.bio: Talks like a pro wrestler cutting a promo and has called himself the greatest of all time since his first match. Plays chaotically and surprisingly well. Claims ToxicXenjax is his tag-team partner, to ToxicXenjax's surprise.
